rules.alternative: whether the current string can become properly balanced and nested by appending zero or more closing parentheses
rules.upstream: whether the entire string is already properly balanced and nested

rules.alternative: greatest total item value with total weight strictly less than the capacity, with each item usable at most once and an empty packing always allowed
rules.upstream: greatest total item value with total weight at most the capacity, with each item usable at most once and an empty packing always allowed

rules.alternative: maximum sum over prefixes beginning at position zero, including the empty prefix
rules.upstream: maximum sum over any contiguous sublist, including the empty sublist

rules.alternative: the distinct input integers in ascending order, keeping exactly one occurrence of each integer
rules.upstream: all input integers in ascending order, retaining every occurrence
